const completionControlStates = [
  `held-publication-changed-promise-demand-input-and-pending-D2`,
  `complete-operator-stop-with-remaining-work`,
  `answer-settled-before-exact-task-dispatch`,
  `existing-window-pending-at-host-gap`,
  `new-partial-window-pending-at-host-gap`,
  `repeated-yield-same-operation-obligation`,
  `quiescent-D2-held-flush-still-pending`,
  `prior-queued-root-and-retained-facade-receipts`,
  `facade-A-commit-before-facade-B-throw`,
  `retained-facade-restoration-receipt-pending`,
  `retry-keeps-task-and-replaces-failed-completion`,
  `old-completion-observer-after-retry`,
  `explicit-rollback-disposal-rejection-after-retry`,
  `unexpected-retained-target-receipt-rejection`,
  `terminal-graph-failure-with-unanswered-peer`,
  `ordinary-demand-failure-keeps-existing-aggregation`,
  `last-receipt-recheck-tail-throws-with-same-revisions`,
  `publication-installed-before-status-tail-throws`,

const completionParametersArbitrary = __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.record({
  keyShift: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.integer({ min: 0, max: 20 }),
  rankScale: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.integer({ min: 1, max: 20 }),
  nonemptyPrior: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.boolean(),
  partial: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.constantFrom(`offset`, `limit`),
  tie: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.boolean(),
  selectedOutput: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.constantFrom(`root`, `facade`),
  answerScheduler: __vite_ssr_import_0__.default.constantFrom(`microtask`, `timer`)
});
const semantic = (action) => ({
  kind: `semantic`,
  action
});
const control = (value) => ({
  kind: `control`,
  control: value
});
const observe = (cut) => ({
  kind: `observe`,
  cut
});
const require = (id, kind) => semantic({ type: `require`, requirement: { id, kind } });
const commonLanes = [
  `host-gap`,
  `repeated-yield`,
  `held-flush`,
  `prior-output`,
  `retry-observer`,
  `cleanup-abandonment`,
  `terminal-graph`,
  `source-aggregation`,
  `last-receipt-tail`,
  `installed-status-tail`,
  `retryable-scope`,
  `stale-task`
];
const completionPathLanes = {
  "query-inline-controlled": commonLanes,
  "query-facade-controlled": [
    ...commonLanes,
    `facade-rollback`,
    `rollback-disposal`
  ],
  "query-inline-native": [`host-gap`],
  "query-facade-native": [`host-gap`],
  "adapter-facade-controlled": [`rollback-disposal`],
  "manager-controlled": [`retryable-scope`]
};
function completionFacts(parameters, retained) {
  const roots = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => ({
    id: parameters.keyShift + index + 1,
    rank: (parameters.tie ? Math.floor(index / 2) + 1 : index + 1) * parameters.rankScale
  }));
  const prior = {
    roots,
    marked: roots.slice(retained || parameters.nonemptyPrior ? 2 : 0).map((row) => row.id),
    children: roots.flatMap((row) => [
      { id: row.id * 100 + 1, parent: row.id },
      { id: row.id * 100 + 2, parent: row.id }
    ])
  };
  const answered = {
    roots: roots.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      rank: row.rank + parameters.rankScale / 10
    })),
    marked: roots.slice(3).map((row) => row.id),
    children: [
      ...prior.children.map((row) => ({ ...row })),
      ...roots.slice(0, 2).map((row) => ({ id: row.id * 100 + 3, parent: row.id }))
    ]
  };
  return { prior, answered };
};
function constructCompletionProgram(parameters, path, lane) {
  if (!completionPathLanes[path].includes(lane))
    throw new Error(`completion grammar: unsupported ${path}/${lane}`);
  const facade = path.includes(`facade`);
  const retained = lane !== `host-gap`;
  const { prior, answered } = completionFacts(parameters, retained);
  const firstBucket = prior.roots[0].id;
  const createdBucket = prior.roots[2].id;
  const target = facade && parameters.selectedOutput === `facade` ? { bucket: firstBucket } : `root`;
  const steps = [
    require(`answer`, `source`),
    require(`tail`, `publication`),
    control(`begin-replay`),
    semantic({
      type: `request-window`,
      operation: `existing`,
      options: { offset: 0, limit: 3 },
      requires: [`answer`, `tail`]
    }),
    control(`release-preceding-replay-answers`),
    control(`wait-trigger`),
    observe(`trigger`),
    control(`wait-complete-operator-stop`),
    observe(`operator-stop`)
  ];
  if (lane === `installed-status-tail`)
    steps.splice(
      0,
      steps.length,
      require(`answer`, `source`),
      require(`tail`, `publication`),
      control(`prepare-held-initial`),
      semantic({
        type: `request-initial`,
        operation: `existing`,
        requires: [`answer`, `tail`]
      })
    );
  const answer = () => semantic({ type: `source-answer`, requirement: `answer`, facts: answered });
  const installAll = () => [
    ...facade ? prior.roots.map(
      (row) => semantic({
        type: `install`,
        target: { bucket: row.id },
        snapshot: `desired`
      })
    ) : [],
    semantic({ type: `install`, target: `root`, snapshot: `desired` })
  ];
  const successfulTail = () => [
    ...installAll(),
    control(`wait-whole-successful-tail`),
    semantic({ type: `tail-success`, requirement: `tail` }),
    observe(`final`)
  ];
  const stageSelected = (id, outputTarget = target, snapshot = `desired`) => [
    require(id, `output`),
    semantic({
      type: `stage-output`,
      requirement: id,
      target: outputTarget,
      snapshot,
      disposition: `retained`
    })
  ];
  const addOutputDependency = (id) => {
    const request = steps.find(
      (step) => step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `request-window`
    );
    if (request?.kind === `semantic` && request.action.type === `request-window`)
      request.action.requires.push(id);
    const declaration = steps.findIndex(
      (step) => step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `require` && step.action.requirement.id === id
    );
    if (declaration >= 0) {
      const [step] = steps.splice(declaration, 1);
      steps.splice(2, 0, step);
    }
  };
  switch (lane) {
    case `host-gap`:
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        control(`wait-host-gap`),
        observe(`host-gap`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `partial`,
          options: parameters.partial === `limit` ? { limit: 1 } : { offset: 1 },
          requires: [`tail`]
        }),
        observe(`host-gap`),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        ...successfulTail()
      );
      break;
    case `repeated-yield`:
      steps.push(require(`second-answer`, `source`));
      addOutputDependency(`second-answer`);
      for (const step of steps)
        if (step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `request-window`)
          step.action.options.limit = 4;
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        control(`wait-second-yield`),
        observe(`repeated-yield`),
        semantic({
          type: `source-answer`,
          requirement: `second-answer`,
          facts: {
            ...answered,
            marked: prior.roots.slice(4).map((row) => row.id)
          }
        }),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        ...successfulTail()
      );
      break;
    case `held-flush`:
      steps.push(
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        control(`wait-held-quiescent-flush`),
        observe(`held-flush`),
        answer(),
        ...successfulTail()
      );
      break;
    case `prior-output`:
      steps.push(...stageSelected(`root-prior`, `root`));
      addOutputDependency(`root-prior`);
      if (facade) {
        steps.push(...stageSelected(`facade-prior`, { bucket: firstBucket }));
        addOutputDependency(`facade-prior`);
      };
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        observe(`receipt-held`),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `root-prior` }),
        ...facade ? [semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `facade-prior` })] : [],
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        ...successfulTail()
      );
      break;
    case `facade-rollback`:
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        ...stageSelected(`facade-A`, { bucket: firstBucket }),
        ...stageSelected(`restore-A`, { bucket: firstBucket }, `restore`)
      );
      addOutputDependency(`facade-A`);
      addOutputDependency(`restore-A`);
      steps.push(
        control(`throw-facade-B-after-A-commit`),
        observe(`facade-attempt-failed`),
        observe(`receipt-held`),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `tail`,
          error: `facade-B`,
          affected: [`existing`]
        }),
        require(`retry-tail`, `publication`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `retry`,
          options: {},
          requires: [`facade-A`, `restore-A`, `retry-tail`]
        }),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `facade-A` }),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `restore-A` }),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        ...installAll(),
        control(`wait-whole-successful-tail`),
        semantic({ type: `tail-success`, requirement: `retry-tail` }),
        observe(`final`)
      );
      break;
    case `retry-observer`:
    case `rollback-disposal`:
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `tail`,
          error: `retryable-tail`,
          affected: [`existing`]
        })
      );
      if (lane === `rollback-disposal`)
        steps.push(
          require(`created`, `output`),
          semantic({
            type: `stage-output`,
            requirement: `created`,
            target: { bucket: createdBucket },
            snapshot: `desired`,
            disposition: `created`
          }),
          semantic({ type: `rollback-dispose`, requirement: `created` })
        );
      steps.push(
        require(`retry-tail`, `publication`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `retry`,
          options: {},
          requires: [`retry-tail`]
        }),
        observe(`retry-attached`),
        control(
          lane === `rollback-disposal` ? `deliver-old-rollback-rejection` : `deliver-old-completion-observer`
        ),
        observe(
          lane === `rollback-disposal` ? `rollback-disposal-delivered` : `old-completion-delivered`
        ),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        ...installAll(),
        control(`wait-whole-successful-tail`),
        semantic({ type: `tail-success`, requirement: `retry-tail` }),
        observe(`final`)
      );
      break;
    case `cleanup-abandonment`:
    case `stale-task`:
      steps.push(...stageSelected(`retained`, target));
      addOutputDependency(`retained`);
      steps.push(
        semantic({ type: `cleanup` }),
        semantic({ type: `restart`, run: `run-2`, facts: answered }),
        require(`new-tail`, `publication`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `current`,
          options: { offset: 0, limit: 2 },
          requires: [`new-tail`]
        }),
        control(`wait-new-live-task`)
      );
      if (lane === `cleanup-abandonment`)
        steps.push(observe(`retained-cleanup-abandoned`));
      steps.push(
        control(`dispatch-stale-task`),
        semantic({ type: `obsolete-delivery`, run: `run-1` }),
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        observe(`stale-task`),
        ...installAll(),
        control(`wait-whole-successful-tail`),
        semantic({ type: `tail-success`, requirement: `new-tail` }),
        observe(`final`)
      );
      break;
    case `terminal-graph`:
      steps.push(
        require(`peer`, `source`),
        semantic({
          type: `request-window`,
          operation: `peer-operation`,
          options: {},
          requires: [`peer`]
        }),
        control(`throw-resumed-graph`),
        semantic({ type: `graph-failure`, error: `graph-error` }),
        observe(`graph-failed`)
      );
      break;
    case `source-aggregation`:
      steps.push(require(`peer`, `source`));
      addOutputDependency(`peer`);
      steps.push(
        semantic({
          type: `source-failure`,
          requirement: `answer`,
          error: `source-error`
        }),
        observe(`source-failed`),
        semantic({
          type: `source-answer`,
          requirement: `peer`,
          facts: answered
        }),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `tail`,
          error: `source-error`,
          affected: [`existing`]
        })
      );
      break;
    case `last-receipt-tail`:
      steps.push(answer(), ...stageSelected(`last-receipt`));
      addOutputDependency(`last-receipt`);
      steps.push(
        control(`dispatch-current-task`),
        observe(`receipt-held`),
        semantic({ type: `apply-output`, requirement: `last-receipt` }),
        control(`throw-last-receipt-recheck-tail`),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `tail`,
          error: `last-receipt-tail`,
          affected: [`existing`]
        }),
        observe(`tail-failed`)
      );
      break;
    case `installed-status-tail`:
    case `retryable-scope`:
      if (lane === `retryable-scope`)
        steps.push(
          require(`unrelated`, `source`),
          semantic({
            type: `request-window`,
            operation: `unattached`,
            options: {},
            requires: [`unrelated`]
          })
        );
      steps.push(
        answer(),
        ...installAll(),
        control(
          lane === `retryable-scope` ? `throw-real-subscriber-tail-after-install` : `throw-real-status-tail-after-install`
        ),
        semantic({
          type: `tail-failure`,
          requirement: `tail`,
          error: `installed-tail`,
          affected: [`existing`]
        }),
        observe(
          lane === `retryable-scope` ? `retryable-scope-failed` : `installed-tail-failed`
        )
      );
      break;
  };
  if (lane === `prior-output` || lane === `cleanup-abandonment` || lane === `stale-task`) {
    const staged = steps.filter(
      (step) => step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `stage-output`
    );
    for (let index = steps.length - 1; index >= 0; index--)
      if (steps[index]?.kind === `semantic` && steps[index].action.type === `stage-output`)
        steps.splice(index, 1);
    const replayIndex = steps.findIndex(
      (step) => step.kind === `control` && step.control === `begin-replay`
    );
    steps.splice(
      replayIndex,
      0,
      semantic({
        type: `source-write`,
        facts: { ...answered, marked: prior.marked }
      }),
      ...staged
    );
  };
  const outputHolds = [];
  for (const step of steps) {
    if (step.kind !== `semantic` || step.action.type !== `stage-output`)
      continue;
    const outputTarget = step.action.target;
    const key = JSON.stringify(outputTarget);
    if (outputHolds.some((hold) => JSON.stringify(hold.target) === key))
      continue;
    const overlay = outputTarget === `root` ? {
      id: `hold-root`,
      kind: `root`,
      row: {
        ...prior.roots[0],
        rank: prior.roots[0].rank - parameters.rankScale / 100,
        children: prior.children.filter((row) => row.parent === firstBucket).map((row) => row.id)
      }
    } : {
      id: `hold-facade-${outputTarget.bucket}`,
      kind: `facade`,
      bucket: outputTarget.bucket,
      rows: [
        ...prior.children.filter((row) => row.parent === outputTarget.bucket).map((row) => row.id),
        outputTarget.bucket * 100 + 99
      ]
    };
    outputHolds.push({ target: outputTarget, overlay });
  };
  if (outputHolds.length > 0) {
    const beforeWork = steps.findIndex(
      (step) => step.kind === `control` || step.kind === `semantic` && step.action.type === `source-write`
    );
    steps.splice(
      beforeWork,
      0,
      ...outputHolds.map(
        (hold) => semantic({ type: `optimistic-overlay`, overlay: hold.overlay })
      ),
      control(`arm-selected-output-holds`)
    );
    const released = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (let index = 0; index < steps.length; index++) {
      const step = steps[index];
      if (step.kind !== `semantic` || step.action.type !== `apply-output`)
        continue;
      const id = step.action.requirement;
      const stage = steps.find(
        (candidate) => candidate.kind === `semantic` && candidate.action.type === `stage-output` && candidate.action.requirement === id
      );
      if (stage?.kind !== `semantic` || stage.action.type !== `stage-output`)
        continue;
      const hold = outputHolds.find(
        (item) => JSON.stringify(item.target) === JSON.stringify(
          stage.action.type === `stage-output` ? stage.action.target : null
        )
      );
      if (released.has(hold.overlay.id)) continue;
      released.add(hold.overlay.id);
      steps.splice(
        index++,
        0,
        semantic({ type: `settle-optimistic`, overlay: hold.overlay.id })
      );
    }
  };
  return {
    path,
    lane,
    parameters,
    answeredFacts: answered,
    outputHolds,
    answerPlan: {
      pivot: parameters.keyShift + 3,
      precedingScope: [parameters.keyShift + 1, parameters.keyShift + 2],
      resolvingScopes: [
        [parameters.keyShift + 3],
        ...lane === `repeated-yield` ? [[parameters.keyShift + 4]] : []
      ],
      retainedScopes: [[parameters.keyShift + 5, parameters.keyShift + 6]]
    },
    setup: {
      run: `run-1`,
      profile: facade ? `facade` : `inline`,
      facts: prior,
      window: {
        offset: 0,
        limit: retained || parameters.nonemptyPrior ? 2 : 0
      },
      ready: lane !== `installed-status-tail`
    },
    steps
  };
};
function completionProgramFamily(parameters) {
  return Object.entries(completionPathLanes).flatMap(
    ([path, lanes]) => lanes.map((lane) => constructCompletionProgram(parameters, path, lane))
  );
};
function statesAt(observation) {
  const state = (index) => completionControlStates[index];
  switch (observation.cut) {
    case `trigger`:
      return [state(0)];
    case `operator-stop`:
      return [state(1)];
    case `host-gap`:
      return [
        state(2),
        state(3),
        ...observation.partialOperation ? [state(4)] : []
      ];
    case `repeated-yield`:
      return [state(5)];
    case `held-flush`:
      return [state(6)];
    case `receipt-held`:
      return [
        ...observation.receipts.some(
          (receipt) => receipt.target === `root` && receipt.beforeFirstStop
        ) && observation.receipts.some(
          (receipt) => receipt.target !== `root` && receipt.beforeFirstStop
        ) ? [state(7)] : [],
        ...observation.receipts.some(
          (receipt) => receipt.role === `restore` && receipt.target !== `root`
        ) ? [state(9)] : []
      ];
    case `facade-attempt-failed`:
      return [state(8)];
    case `retry-attached`:
      return [state(10)];
    case `old-completion-delivered`:
      return [state(11)];
    case `rollback-disposal-delivered`:
      return [state(12)];
    // The old raw name stays discoverable. Its required legal witness is now
    // acceptance -> cleanup start -> AbortError abandonment of a retained
    // target -> a live replacement. It grants no same-run rejection policy.
    case `retained-cleanup-abandoned`:
      return [state(13)];
    case `graph-failed`:
      return [state(14)];
    case `source-failed`:
      return [state(15)];
    case `tail-failed`:
      return [state(16)];
    case `installed-tail-failed`:
      return [state(17)];
    case `retryable-scope-failed`:
      return [state(18)];
    case `stale-task`:
      return [state(19)];
    case `final`:
      return [];
  }
}
const inlineStates = completionControlStates.filter(
  (_, index) => ![7, 8, 9, 12].includes(index)
);
const completionPathStates = {
  "query-inline-controlled": inlineStates,
  "query-facade-controlled": completionControlStates,
  "query-inline-native": completionControlStates.slice(0, 5),
  "query-facade-native": completionControlStates.slice(0, 5),
  "adapter-facade-controlled": [
    completionControlStates[0],
    completionControlStates[1],
    completionControlStates[10],
    completionControlStates[12]
  ],
  "manager-controlled": [
    completionControlStates[0],
    completionControlStates[1],
    completionControlStates[18]
  ]
};
function createCompletionReach(replaying) {
  const paths = Object.keys(completionPathStates).map(
    (path) => [
      path,
      (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.createOracleReach)(
        `query.queued-answer-completion.${path}`,
        completionPathStates[path],
        { replaying }
      )
    ]
  );
  const reaches = new Map(paths);
  return {
    beginHistory(path) {
      reaches.get(path).beginHistory();
    },
    observe(path, model, observation) {
      (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.checkCompletionObservation)(model, observation);
      const declared = completionPathStates[path];
      for (const state of statesAt(observation))
        if (declared.includes(state)) reaches.get(path).reach(state);
    },
    counts() {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        paths.map(([path, reach]) => [
          path,
          Object.fromEntries(reach.counts())
        ])
      );
    },
    assertReached() {
      for (const [, reach] of paths) reach.assertReached();
    }
  };
};
(0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.declareOracle)({
  grammar: [
    completionParametersArbitrary,
    constructCompletionProgram,
    completionProgramFamily,
    completionFacts
  ],
  check: [createCompletionReach]
});
